input: Find out if my neighborhood has a community tool shed

gold.taskTitle: Find a community tool shed in your neighborhood
gold.taskDescription: Research whether the user's local neighborhood has a shared community tool shed available for residents to use.

questions.title: What city, town, or specific neighborhood do you live in?
questions.description: Knowing the exact location helps narrow the search to relevant local resources.

questions.title: Do you rent, own, or live in a managed community like an HOA?
questions.description: Understanding the housing situation helps identify whether a tool shed might be managed by an HOA, landlord, or a public organization.

questions.title: Have you already checked with anyone locally about this?
questions.description: Knowing what the user has already tried avoids duplicating effort.

questions.title: What specific tools are you hoping to borrow or access?
questions.description: The type of tools needed may point to specific programs, libraries, or makerspaces rather than a general community shed.

questions.title: Is this a one-time need or ongoing regular access?
questions.description: Understanding frequency helps determine whether finding a community shed or another borrowing solution is the best fit.

questions.title: Are you open to options slightly outside your immediate neighborhood?
questions.description: Nearby tool libraries, maker spaces, or municipal programs may exist just outside the immediate area.

questions.title: Would you also want to know how to start one if none exists?
questions.description: If no tool shed is found, the user may want guidance on organizing or proposing one in their community.
